KARANDI · NGARUA AREA

A Kenyan setting.
A warm invitation.

Joy Ripples is in Karandi, in the Ngarua area of Laikipia near the Laikipia–Baringo border. The gardens and outdoor spaces are part of the resort experience.

Plan your arrival

VISITING FROM FURTHER AWAY?

A few useful starting points.

Talk across time zones

Kenya uses East Africa Time, UTC+3. Share your country and preferred time when requesting a conversation.

Call +254 722 693 407

Confirm your quotation

Website menu estimates are in Kenyan shillings (KES). Ask the resort to confirm the full price, inclusions and payment arrangements.

Discuss your visit

Plan the last part of your journey

Request the exact entrance pin before travelling. Discuss your arrival timing and any transport needs with the team.
